title: Idiocy's Craftable Discs!
description: This Mod adds the ability to make an Empty disc, which you can then use wool to make into any non structure obtained discs. The mod also includes 1 special Disc (Greens Jam from AaronGrooves)
body: This mod adds craftable discs to minecraft, where you use the Empty Disc as a template, then use wool to put songs on it. (there is also a extra song from the allen becker "Animation Vs Minecraft" series.)
